answers.description: Pterodactyl is a highly customizable, ultra-low-cost system optimized for binary classification in translation triage and data curation. It is based on an LLM-as-a-judge approach, with prompt engineering and model selection guided by ROC analysis. Wukongopterus is derived from Pterodactyl and specifically optimized for Task 3, employing a threshold-setting strategy based on one set of patterns observed in the WMT25 data.
answers.name: Wukongopterus, a variant of Pterodactyl
